senses.gloss: f., with suffix גִּתּ־, גִּיתּ־ (b. h.; vat for wine pressing; (שעת)הג׳ the season of wine pressing.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 5:11">Ab. Zar. V, 11</cite> <he>ג׳ של אבן</he> a stone vat, <he>של חרס</he> an earthen.
<cite ref="Mishnah Avodah Zarah 4:8">Ib. IV, 8</cite>, v. <cite ref="B01032"><he>בָּעַט</he></cite>.
